Prime-square stationary phase is an exact grouping identity; zero, one and two critical roots are disjoint and two odd-order roots of unity cannot cancel. The h multiple p cases are separately exhausted and all survival counts sum to R_p. The standalone exact cyclotomic checker exhaustively matches all 46,592 cells for p=5,7,11,13 at both exponents; numerical Gram comparisons independently check eigenvalue normalization. Computations support, not replace, the general proof.

value.rationale: Full operator-valued Gabor measurements of polynomial-phase windows have natural relevance to time-frequency inverse problems. The theorem gives a complete nonzero-versus-zero Weyl-coordinate classification at the first ramified cyclic ring and establishes a sharp loss from asymptotically complete operator span at p to one-half at p^2. The prime-mod-3 correction, quadratic-residue wall and exactly quantified kernel are structural, infinite-family outcomes rather than a small parameter increment or an isolated numerical table. No unproved signal-recovery or stability consequence is advertised.
